title: Cython typed memoryview Fortran-contiguous stride cast crash
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0394: Cython typed memoryview Fortran-contiguous stride cast crash
Repository: `cython/cython`
Category: `Compiler IR Optimization & SSA Lowering`
Target File: `Cython/Compiler/ExprNodes.py`

#### Problem Description
Direct cast of 2D Fortran-ordered array to C-contiguous memoryview leads to out-of-bounds pointer calculation.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Verify memoryview contiguity flags and generate explicit transpose buffer when order differs.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0394.py -q`
expected_invariant: Verify memoryview contiguity flags and generate explicit transpose buffer when order differs.
